rule.title: Expenses reimbursed or paid by others are not medical expenses

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Was this expense reimbursed, or paid by insurance, an HSA or MSA distribution, or anyone else?

citation.wording: Caution: Do not include expenses reimbursed or paid by others.

rule.open_point: A PARTIAL reimbursement reduces the item by the amount reimbursed; no operator reduces a figure by an answered amount, so the record should carry the unreimbursed part as the item and this rule answers only the wholly reimbursed case.
